ارتعشت (form VIII)

# اِرْتَعَشْتَ (irtaʕašta) /ir.ta.ʕaʃ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
# اِرْتَعَشْتِ (irtaʕašti) /ir.ta.ʕaʃ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
# اِرْتَعَشَتْ (irtaʕašat) /ir.ta.ʕa.ʃat/: third-perso
